**DZ501** is a medical diagnosis code that denotes "contact for other physiotherapy" (*Kontakt mhp. anden fysioterapi*) [^src1]. While the code itself refers to a rehabilitation or therapy encounter, it holds specific methodological significance within the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring frameworks, particularly for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1].

In the annual quality reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) for the national atrial fibrillation database (AFDK), DZ501 is utilized in combination with the cerebrovascular codes [[di63|DI63]] and [[di64|DI64]] to identify cases of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke) [^src1] [^src5]. Specifically, data is extracted from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (Danish National Patient Registry) to capture patient trajectories where DZ501 is registered as the primary action diagnosis alongside DI63 or DI64 as a secondary diagnosis [^src2] [^src4]. 

This specific combination of codes is a foundational element for calculating the incidence rate of ischemic stroke among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients [^src1] [^src4]. Tracking this incidence serves as a crucial clinical quality indicator (Indicator 5), acting as a proxy measure for insufficient anticoagulation therapy and allowing health authorities to evaluate and compare treatment safety and effectiveness across Danish regions and health clusters [^src4].
